title: Stephen Bond
text: Hey! Don’t worry a dog isn’t writing this website page, I just needed a placeholder for my profile picture (I will change it soon my phone is just dead and I have no photos of me on my computer) I’m Stephen Bond a current third year Environmental Studies major with a concentration in Physical Geography at UCSB. While I currently call Santa Barbara home, I am originally from Massachusetts. Professionally, I love working for local government whether it be IVCSD or SBCAG! In my free time I love volunteering with Sprout Up, hanging out with friends, or just napping. I hope you enjoy learning more about me on this crazy wicked website!
